description: This grouped bar chart, which is visually presented at a tilted angle, illustrates a "Model Evaluation on Academic and..." (with the remainder of the title obscured), comparing performance scores across various benchmarks. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," displays nine categories arranged from left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," uses a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 80, featuring numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 10. Within each category on the horizontal axis, there are two adjacent bars. According to the partially visible legend in the upper right corner, the blue bars positioned on the left of each group represent a model with a label beginning "Llama-...", while the orange bars on the right represent a model labeled "Ours (Iterative...". The blue bars vary in height, ranging from a minimum approximate value of 45 for Chat-Arena-Hard to a maximum of roughly 80 for MBPP. The orange bars range from a low of approximately 62 for LC AlpacaEval-2 to a high of roughly 82 for GSM-8K, ARC, and MBPP. The categories are not sorted in a strict alphabetical or ascending/descending numerical order, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with special shading, bolding, or outlines.
